title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #13

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. With which side should we start when putting on shoes? (1 mark)
   A. Right
   B. Neither
   C. Left
   D. Either

2. Which of these was freed by Abu Bakr? (1 mark)
   A. Bilal
   B. Waraqa
   C. Abu Lahab
   D. Abu Talib

3. How many verses does Surah Al-Falaq have? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 5
   C. 3
   D. 6

4. What does physical fitness mean? (1 mark)
   A. A healthy, active and strong body
   B. Having many clothes
   C. Sleeping a lot
   D. Eating sweets

5. Which two names come from the word "rahmah"? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Malik and As-Salam
   B. As-Sami' and Al-Basir
   C. Ar-Rahman and Al-Malik
   D. Ar-Rahman and Ar-Rahim

6. Which of these is print media? (1 mark)
   A. Radio
   B. Newspaper
   C. Television
   D. Film

7. Who is a "binamu"? (1 mark)
   A. Uncle
   B. Cousin
   C. Aunt
   D. Grandfather

8. Why do animals give us benefit? (1 mark)
   A. They give us food, milk, work and transport
   B. They are useless
   C. They only eat
   D. They cannot help

9. About how old was the Prophet at the first revelation? (1 mark)
   A. About forty
   B. About ten
   C. About sixty
   D. About twenty

10. Which food is worst for teeth if we do not brush after? (1 mark)
   A. Sweets and sugary drinks
   B. Cabbage
   C. Water
   D. Plain rice

11. A baby girl's urine falls on a mat. What type of najasa is it? (1 mark)
   A. Medium
   B. Light
   C. Heavy
   D. Not a najasa

12. What is the collection of Allah's most beautiful names called? (1 mark)
   A. Arkan
   B. Tajweed
   C. Asma'ul Husna
   D. Sunnah

13. What should we say after finishing a meal? (1 mark)
   A. Alhamdulillah
   B. Amin
   C. Bismillah
   D. Inna lillahi

14. Which of these is a mobile phone use that follows Islamic manners? (1 mark)
   A. Sending unkind messages
   B. Sharing private photos
   C. Calling a relative to greet them
   D. Playing during prayer

15. Who is called "Ar-Ruh al-Amin", the Trustworthy Spirit? (1 mark)
   A. Jibril
   B. Raqib
   C. Israfil
   D. Mikail

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. State the duties of Jibril, Mikail and Israfil. (3 marks)

17. Explain why we say Bismillah before eating. (3 marks)

18. Name the seven parts of the body that touch the ground in sujud. (3 marks)

19. Give three positive uses of media. (3 marks)

20. Give three benefits of the Islamic dress code. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Right
   Recorded in Al-Bukhari and Muslim.

2. A — Bilal
   Bilal was freed.

3. B — 5
   Al-Falaq has five verses.

4. A — A healthy, active and strong body
   Fitness means the body is healthy.

5. D — Ar-Rahman and Ar-Rahim
   Rahmah means mercy.

6. B — Newspaper
   Print media is printed on paper.

7. B — Cousin
   Binamu means cousin.

8. A — They give us food, milk, work and transport
   Animals serve people.

9. A — About forty
   He was about forty.

10. A — Sweets and sugary drinks
   Sugar feeds germs.

11. A — Medium
   Baby girl's urine is washed as medium najasa in this teaching.

12. C — Asma'ul Husna
   Asma'ul Husna means the Most Beautiful Names.

13. A — Alhamdulillah
   Alhamdulillah thanks Allah for the food.

14. C — Calling a relative to greet them
   Keeping ties is good.

15. A — Jibril
   This title refers to Jibril.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: Jibril brings revelation, Mikail is in charge of rain and provision, Israfil will blow the Trumpet.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: We ask for Allah's blessing and remember that food is from Him. It makes eating an act of worship.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Forehead with nose, two palms, two knees and toes of both feet.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for forehead, 1 mark for palms and knees, 1 mark for toes.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: Learning, listening to Qur'an and lessons, keeping in touch with family, news, safe skills.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: Protection, dignity and respect, trains modesty and self-control, obedience to Allah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each benefit.
